notes: High-level: want private VPC deployment for PHI workflows. Very strict residency + audit requirements.
Encryption posture is primary ask — detailed notes from SecDeepDive:
- In-transit: require mutual TLS between customer LB and Redwood ingress. TLS 1.3 preferred, TLS1.2 acceptable with strong cipher suites.
- mTLS: customer will provision client certs; Redwood to validate client certs against customer CA OR offer mutual-auth with customer-managed certs via ACM in customer's account.
- Service-to-service: internal mTLS between runtime components for zero-trust, cert rotation handled by control plane with cert expiry <90 days.
- At-rest: AES-256-GCM envelope encryption for model KV cache and user data; per-tenant data keys wrapped by customer CMK when BYOK selected.
- Key rotation: recommend two-tier rotation: data-key rotation every 90 days, CMK rotation policy annually (customer can trigger rotation). Rewrap flow documented; no downtime for POC.
- KMS integration: support for AWS KMS (cross-account), AWS CloudHSM, and external HSM via PKCS#11 (enterprise package). BYOK model preferred.
- Secrets management: recommend HashiCorp Vault in customer VPC (auto-unseal with KMS) or AWS Secrets Manager; Redwood control plane will not persist plaintext keys for private VPC.

- Audit logging: immutable write-once logs forwarded to customer SIEM (Splunk/Datadog/Elastic). Retention policy requested: 7 years for audit trails; must include request metadata + token usage (redacted PII).
- Data residency: all inference inputs/outputs must remain in us-east-1; no cross-region backups without explicit consent.
- Network topology: private endpoints (AWS PrivateLink) only; no NAT egress for inference traffic. Customer will provide VPC peering/VPN terms.
- Operational controls: RBAC via SSO/SAML, granular route-level policies, per-route key binding (bind a CMK to a model route).
- Compliance asks: provide SOC2 Type II evidence, ISO27001 cert, results of recent pen test + remediation plan.
Customer quotes / call fragments:
- 'We cannot have keys managed by a vendor control plane unless wrapped by our CMK.'
- 'Audit logs must be tamper-evident and stored in our SIEM; we will supply log ingestion credentials.'
POC scope notes: sample dataset de-identification pipeline + RAG with customer KMS BYOK; latency target 200ms P50 for short prompts; throughput 60 QPS burstable to 200 for evaluation.
Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay for isolation and BYOK HSM but want clear unit economics for heavy embedding batches.
Action items from last call: AE to share architecture diagram, SE to draft BYOK integration steps, Security to prepare BRD + evidence pack.
